name: Lada
description: Goddess of beauty, love, harmony, and marriage. Her name echoes in ancient Slavic ritual songs sung across all Slavic lands.
mythology: Lada is the goddess of beauty, love, harmony, marriage, and spring. Her name is the root of the Slavic word 'lad' — harmony, order, and peace. She appears as a radiant young woman crowned with flowers. Her name and that of her male counterpart Lado appear as a ritual refrain in countless ancient Slavic ceremonial songs (lada, lado, lado!), demonstrating her deep integration into folk music, wedding rites, and seasonal celebration. She presides over all love unions and marriages. In spring and summer she is honored with songs, circle dances (khorovod), and flower garlands. She is possibly cognate with the Baltic Laima, goddess of luck and fate.
